document.title: Record reviewer decisions without losing product truth
document.summary: Reviewers can choose, explain, record, and export a real product decision while canonical approval remains explicit.
document.reviewFocus: Choose the retention policy, provide rationale, and verify that browser recording is not treated as approval.

sections.title: Reviewers can create a portable decision record

items: A PRD contains a real unresolved choice
Select, explain, record, and export the choice
Browser state does not approve canonical product truth

sections.title: Selections previously stopped at ephemeral browser state

blocks.text: A reviewer could select an option, but the report did not distinguish a saved choice from an explicitly approved product decision.

blocks.title: Trust gap
blocks.text: An agent could mistake local completeness for product approval.

sections.title: Recording and approval remain separate actions

items.title: Select
items.text: The reviewer selects a known option or writes a custom answer.

items.title: Explain
items.text: The reviewer provides rationale and identifies the owner.

items.title: Record
items.text: The checkbox persists a portable review record.

items.title: Reconcile
items.text: An agent updates canonical source only after explicit approval.

sections.title: A decision moves from question to canonical truth

blocks.question: How does a reviewer choice become portable without becoming implicit approval?
blocks.caption: The review record is exported before explicit approval changes canonical truth.
walkthrough: Start from the unresolved reviewer question.
Record the selected option with rationale and owner.
Export the portable Markdown review record.
Apply only explicitly approved choices to canonical source.

sections.title: Record one review decision end to end

blocks.title: Record and export a reviewer choice
blocks.outcome: A reviewer leaves a portable, agent-readable decision record.
blocks.boundary: The action does not mark the PRD Approved or modify its source.

story.capability: record a selected option with rationale
story.outcome: the product owner can reconcile an explicit decision

scenarios.title: Main scenario
scenarios.given: a report contains an unresolved product decision
scenarios.when: the reviewer selects an option, enters rationale and owner, and checks Decision recorded
scenarios.then: the choice persists locally and exports as Markdown marked as review input

scenarios.title: Incomplete record
scenarios.given: one required decision field is empty
scenarios.when: the reviewer tries to record the choice
scenarios.then: the checkbox remains unavailable and explains what is missing

steps.title: Choose
steps.context: The open decision shows real options and a custom answer.
steps.outcome: The rationale and owner fields become the next required work.

steps.title: Record
steps.context: Selection, rationale, and owner are complete.
steps.response: The report confirms local persistence and offers export.
steps.outcome: The reviewer downloads an agent-readable Markdown record.

acceptance.text: Recording is unavailable until selection, rationale, and owner are present.
Reloading restores a locally recorded review decision.
Export identifies the stable decision ID and states that the record is not approval.

blocks.after: After this slice, a reviewer can leave a portable decision record without silently approving or modifying product truth.

sections.title: Canonical approval stays outside browser persistence

items: In scope: local persistence and Markdown export.
In scope: explicit distinction between review input and accepted truth.
Out of scope: automatic source-file mutation or implied approval.

sections.title: Choose how long local review input remains available

blocks.question: How long should browser-local review input remain available?

options.label: Persist until manually replaced or cleared

blocks.rationale: Review may span reloads before the exported record is reconciled.
